transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, my name is Paige. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Paige. Our S-Net Web Safe parental control filter has suddenly started blocking my daughter's university medical research portal, and she has an assignment deadline tonight that she can't access.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how urgent this is when your daughter has a university assignment deadline tonight. I will check your Web Safe settings and unblock that portal right away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Paige. She was in tears because the page keeps throwing up an S-Net Content Blocked warning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we access your broadband security settings, could you please confirm your full installation address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 31 St Catherine's Way, Gloucester, GL1 2DD, and the security PIN is 6381.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming your address and PIN. I have your broadband safety account open on our security gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks for getting that open.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to confirm what is happening: your broadband Web Safe filter is incorrectly flagging an educational university medical portal as restricted content, blocking access ahead of an urgent academic deadline. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly that. The website address is biomed-portal.ox.ac.uk, and it contains academic journals on pharmacology.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our Web Safe system operates two distinct filtering categories: Child Safe, which restricts adult content, and Virus Safe, which blocks suspicious IP addresses and unverified domain certificates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would an Oxford University medical portal get blocked by Virus Safe?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Checking our threat intelligence database... the university portal recently updated its SSL security certificate to a new intermediate authority that our automated scanner had not yet white-listed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, so the new certificate triggered a false positive flag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Precisely. Our automated heuristic scanner flagged the domain as containing unverified SSL authority certificates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you add that domain to our personal whitelist so our home network bypasses the block?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I can add biomed-portal.ox.ac.uk directly to your account's Trusted Domains whitelist right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the whitelist take effect immediately or does it take hours to replicate?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When we add a domain to your individual household whitelist, the DNS policy pushes down to your Hub router within about two minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is fantastic, she can get straight back to her research.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are there any subdomains on that university portal that she also accesses, such as library or student portal subdomains?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, library.ox.ac.uk and canvas.ox.ac.uk are also used heavily for her course.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will add a wildcard entry for *.ox.ac.uk so that all educational subdomains under the university domain remain permanently accessible.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Adding the wildcard is a brilliant idea, that will stop any other pages breaking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me also verify your Virus Safe settings so malware protection remains active on all other browsing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, we definitely still want protection against phishing and malicious links.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Virus Safe will continue scanning all external web traffic for known malicious signatures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the Web Safe filter apply to Wi-Fi guest networks if we have guests over at the house?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, any device connecting to your primary Wi-Fi SSID or your separate Guest Wi-Fi network inherits the household Web Safe DNS filtering rules.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we set different filtering rules for different devices in the home?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Currently, Web Safe operates at the gateway router level across all local IP addresses, but individual device scheduling is available under our Advanced Security add-on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know, but for now having the university domains open for my daughter is all we needed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can my daughter access the university portal when she connects from her mobile phone over 4G mobile data as well?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Mobile data uses the mobile carrier's DNS servers rather than your home broadband Hub, so her university portal will work on 4G without any S-Net Web Safe restrictions.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's great, so she can continue reading research papers on her commute into campus.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does she also use remote desktop software to access university lab computers, such as TeamViewer or Microsoft Remote Desktop?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, she uses remote desktop to access the chemistry simulation software running on campus workstations.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Remote desktop protocols utilize specific outbound ports like 3389, which are unrestricted under standard Web Safe settings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the Web Safe filter scan incoming downloaded PDF research files for embedded malware?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, Virus Safe uses real-time packet inspection to scan downloaded files and attachments against known virus signature databases.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's great because medical research archives often host compressed archive files.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It provides continuous network-level security without requiring third-party antivirus software on her laptop.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm relieved that won't be blocked either when she runs lab simulations.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please bear with me while I place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while I push the wildcard domain whitelist to your Hub.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience while waiting. The wildcard whitelist has been applied to your router's DNS profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Paige. Let me ask my daughter to refresh the page on her laptop upstairs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have her flush her browser cache or open the page in an incognito window to ensure it doesn't load a cached error page.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She's opening an incognito window now... typing biomed-portal.ox.ac.uk... and it loaded! The full medical journal dashboard popped up with no blocking screen!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's wonderful! Is she able to log in with her student credentials and download the necessary research papers?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She just logged in and downloaded her PDF assignment brief. She says to give you a massive thank you!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so delighted she can complete her assignment on time without any further stress.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And are the other university subdomains working cleanly too?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could she click through to the library catalog to verify the wildcard policy?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking the library link... yes, library.ox.ac.uk opened instantly with full access.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The wildcard rule is propagating perfectly across your local DNS cache.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have no idea what a lifesaver this was tonight. Her deadline was midnight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have locked that trusted domain whitelist onto your account profile so it will never revert during future automated security updates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That proactive locking gives us total peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are there any other educational websites or study tools that she needs whitelisted while we are in your profile?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about NCBI PubMed and ScienceDirect? Are they whitelisted by default?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, major scientific and medical publishing domains like PubMed and ScienceDirect are verified global whitelist entries on S-Net.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's good, so she won't run into another wall when citing references.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you also check if her university VPN connects properly through the router firewall?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She's launching the university Cisco AnyConnect VPN now... yes, green checkmark, connected!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: IPsec and SSL VPN pass-through are enabled by default on Hub firmware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything is working like clockwork now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your broadband security or parental controls that I can assist with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Paige, you sorted out the emergency in minutes. Thank you so much!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today. Wish your daughter the best of luck with her assignment and have a wonderful evening.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks Paige, take care. Goodbye!
